title: Troll Tales at Children's Cave 1-Hour Tour in Saint Paul
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Join us on our unique Kid-Friendly Cave Tour during holiday breaks, and every second Sunday of the month, except Oct. Nov. Dec. We've tailored our most popular Historic Cave Tour to be shared with the young and the young-at-heart. We’ll talk about mines and mushrooms and share old photographs from the early days of the Caves. Kids can talk about what interests them, and ask questions about trolls and times of long ago.

Included in this special tour:

A walkthrough and hands-on tour of the caves guided by one of the lovable and kind trolls that reside here.
A unique craft to take home and share with family
Photo and meet and greet opportunities
 $10 per person. Kids under 2 are free.
